description: This file defines a factory function 'AnscCreateSimpleClientTcp' to create a new instance of a Simple Client TCP object within the ANSC framework. It includes licensing information, module description, and references an external creation function 'AnscSctoCreate'.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCreateSimpleClientTcp(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a new Simple Client TCP object, taking three context handles as arguments.
